# #681 — [cutover-blocker] Liveness observer blind to the 'tool' role — dead 8 days (14,006 rows frozen), /health reads green

Found by two independent capture audits (2026-08-09), CONFIRMED by the controller directly this session (live DB + live /health).

## The #447 pattern, live on our cutover evidence
liveness-observer.ts:79 EXPECTED_ROLES = ["user","assistant"] seeds only two roles, but the server accepts three (src/tools/ingest-raw-turn.ts:107: z.enum(["user","assistant","tool"])). Silent-role detection iterates Object.entries(observation.turnsByRole), so a role neither seeded nor present in the query rows is NEVER judged.

Silent path: tool capture dies -> no rows -> no GROUP BY group -> key absent from turnsByRole -> excluded from silentRoles -> stale:false.

## Confirmed live (controller, this session)
DB: role tool last wrote 2026-08-01 00:42 = 191.9 HOURS (8 days) ago, 14,006 rows frozen; user/assistant both 0.0h ago.
Live /health at f673299 concurrently: silent_roles:[] | stale:False | reason:"capture lane delivering".

rg -n "tool" server/capture/liveness-observer.test.ts -> nothing. The role is never exercised in the observer's 8 tests.

This is exactly the failure the module's own docstring (liveness-observer.ts:22-25) cites as its reason to exist, reported green over a dead role for 8 days.

## Note (separate finding, same audit): the seed itself works for the roles it covers
The other audit proved per-role seeding DOES catch a dead user or assistant (both directions tested against the live judge) — the fix at :239 works. The gap is specifically that `tool` is not in the seed list. So the fix is small: add "tool" to EXPECTED_ROLES and seed it, OR derive expected roles from the accepted enum so the two can't drift.

## Why cutover blocker
The liveness observer IS the cutover's evidence that capture works (#647/#648/#652/#656). If it reports green over a dead role, we cannot trust it to tell us capture is healthy on core01. And `tool` turns carry tool-call/result content — not negligible.

## Wanted
1. Seed EXPECTED_ROLES from the ingest enum (single source of truth) so a new role can't silently escape liveness. 
2. Done-means: a dead `tool` role with live user/assistant must produce stale=true silent_roles=[tool].
3. Investigate WHY tool capture stopped 2026-08-01 (may be related to the quarantine drops in #680 — 5 of the 15 quarantined turns were role:tool).

Truth grammar: RUNNING — confirmed against live DB and live /health this session.
